single.rationale: UEC shows highly erratic revenue ($224K in FY24, $66.8M in FY25) with persistent operating losses (-$73M in FY25), negative operating margins (-110%), and cash burn ($70M negative FCF). While the company is positioning itself in uranium with multiple acquisitions and restart of Christensen Ranch, it remains pre-commercial with significant execution risk, dilution (share count up 8% YoY), and no off-take agreements despite a $5B market cap and 74x EV/revenue multiple.
